No supply-side evidence line available.
note: ACMA is an industry association / lobby body (ISO 9001:2015 certified, publishes an annual report and a member directory of ~800+ auto-component firms), not a manufacturer or trader of goods. It does not itself ship HS 870899 parts; the declared HS code and the 'Авиастроение и транспорт' industry label describe its members' sector, not its own trade. Its website lists member companies (e.g. 'A. G.Industries Pvt. Ltd.', 'Advik Hi-Tech Pvt. Ltd.') — those are the actual potential suppliers and would need to be verified individually.
